entities.summary: The ETH Library, serving as the central university library at ETH Zurich, has a notable collection of scientific and technical information. It is considered one of the largest public scientific and technical libraries in Switzerland. Furthermore, it offers resources for the public and companies in research and development. Particular emphasis is placed on electronic information for university members and the development of innovative services.
